description: Collect public Shopee shop profiles, item details, category trees and mall shops across eight markets.

categoryId.description: Numeric category ID from categoryTree mode, or a category name. Leave blank for the whole tree (mode=categoryTree).
categoryId.title: Category ID or name

includeChildren.description: Include child categories (mode=categoryTree). When categoryId is blank, false returns only top-level categories.
includeChildren.title: Include child categories

includeFeaturedItem.description: Add the featured product card published on the shop page; on itemByUrl, merge it when the item matches.
includeFeaturedItem.title: Include featured product

includeShopCategories.description: Add the shop's own category list to the shop record (mode=shopProfile).
includeShopCategories.title: Include shop categories

market.description: Shopee market. Used for categoryTree, mallShops and bare IDs; a full URL keeps its own market.
market.title: Market

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Use 500 for a complete category tree.
maxItems.title: Max records

shopUrl.description: Shop username, numeric shop ID, /shop/<id> path, or full Shopee shop URL (mode=shopProfile).
shopUrl.title: Shop URL or username

title: Shopee Scraper Input
